items.en: Results. Table 2 shows the clearest advantage of Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B. It achieves an average of 64.1, outperforming Embodied-R1.5, the strongest parameter-comparable baseline in this category, by 5.3 points (64.1 vs. 58.8). The model ranks first on five of the eight benchmarks—FineBench, CrossHOI-Bench, PIO, ShareRobot-Bench-Trajectory, and RoboBench-MCQ—and second on VABench-Point. These gains consistently cover interaction recognition, action grounding, trajectory prediction, and local robotic decision-making. The results therefore show that the model does more than perceive a scene accurately: it can convert observations into grounded action choices and reason about the physical transitions induced by those actions. This strong action-oriented reasoning is central to its role as an efficient physical-world agent.
items.zh: 结果。表2显示了Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B最明显的优势。它平均得分为64.1，比该类别中最强的参数相当基线Embodied-R1.5高出5.3分（64.1对58.8）。该模型在八个基准测试中的五个（FineBench、CrossHOI-Bench、PIO、ShareRobot-Bench-轨迹和RoboBench-MCQ）上排名第一，在VABench-Point上排名第二。这些提升一致地涵盖了交互识别、动作定位、轨迹预测和局部机器人决策。因此，结果表明该模型不仅能准确感知场景，还能将观察转化为具体的动作选择，并推理由这些动作引起的物理转变。这种强动作导向的推理是其作为高效物理世界智能体角色的核心。

items.capEn: Figure 6: Qualitative analysis of action-transition reasoning. Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B recognizes interaction intent, selects progress-consistent actions, grounds directional decisions, and reasons about local physical feasibility and viewpoint-dependent effects.

items.en: Qualitative Analysis. The cases in Figure 6 reveal how Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B reasons across the state–action boundary. For interaction understanding, it identifies the social dynamics in a short video and determines the object attended to by a person from gaze, pose, and scene context. For action decision and grounding, the model tracks the progress of a utensil-cleaning sequence to select “place lid on container” as the appropriate next step, and infers the required downward motion for inserting a controller component into its slot. The physical-feasibility cases further require embodied frame transformation: the model selects a forward-right gripper motion to place a knife on a cloth and predicts how moving a bicycle in one camera view changes its apparent trajectory in another. These examples demonstrate that the model jointly uses interaction semantics, temporal progress, spatial grounding, and local physical constraints to select actions whose effects are consistent with the scene.
items.zh: 定性分析。图6中的案例揭示了Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B如何在状态-动作边界上进行推理。对于交互理解，它识别短视频中的社会动态，并根据视线、姿态和场景上下文确定一个人所关注的物体。对于动作决策与定位，模型跟踪厨具清洗序列的进度，选择“将盖子放在容器上”作为适当的下一步，并推断将控制器组件插入其插槽所需的向下动作。物理可行性案例进一步要求具身框架变换：模型选择向右前方的夹爪运动将刀放在布上，并预测在一个摄像头视野中移动自行车如何改变其在另一个视野中的表观轨迹。这些例子表明，模型联合使用交互语义、时间进度、空间定位和局部物理约束来选择动作，其效果与场景一致。

items.en: Capability. Real-world tasks unfold over multiple steps and rarely proceed exactly as planned. A capable agent must preserve relevant history, determine how far execution has progressed, compose local actions into a long-horizon plan, detect when an intended subtask has failed, and revise its behavior accordingly. Sequential and adaptive reasoning enables persistent agency: it prevents the model from treating each observation independently and allows it to continue making progress under changing or imperfect execution conditions.
items.zh: 能力。现实世界的任务涉及多个步骤，且很少完全按计划进行。一个有能力（capable）的智能体必须保留相关历史记录，确定执行进度，将局部动作组合为长期规划，检测意图的子任务是否失败，并相应调整其行为。顺序与自适应推理实现了持久性智能体能力：它防止模型独立处理每个观测，并允许其在变化或不完美的执行条件下继续取得进展。

items.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate this capability on seven benchmarks spanning three groups. History- and Progress-Aware Reasoning uses SITE-Bench-Video, VSIBench, EgoPlan2, and Cosmos to test whether the model can integrate temporal observations with action history and task progress. Long-Horizon Planning and Composition is evaluated on VLABench and RoboBench-Planning, which require composing multiple actions toward a distant objective. Finally, RoboFAC evaluates Reflection, Repair, and Recovery, testing whether the model can identify a failure and revise its behavior. Together, these benchmarks assess the temporal memory, planning, self-correction, and recovery capabilities required in dynamic physical environments.
items.zh: 基准测试。我们在七个基准测试上评估这一能力，分为三组。历史与进度感知推理（History- and Progress-Aware Reasoning）使用SITE-Bench-Video、VSIBench、EgoPlan2和Cosmos来测试模型是否能够将时间观测与动作历史和任务进度整合。长期规划与组合（Long-Horizon Planning and Composition）在VLABench和RoboBench-Planning上进行评估，这些基准要求组合多个动作以实现遥远目标。最后，RoboFAC评估反思、修复与恢复（Reflection, Repair, and Recovery），测试模型是否能够识别失败并调整其行为。这些基准共同评估了动态物理环境所需的时间记忆、规划、自我修正和恢复能力。

items.en: Results. As reported in Table 3, Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B again achieves the highest average among parameter-comparable models, reaching 57.4 and outperforming Qwen3.6-A3B by 1.4 points (57.4 vs. 55.9). It ranks first on VLABench, RoboBench-Planning, and RoboFAC and second on SITE-Bench-Video. The model consequently demonstrates competitive capability across temporal understanding, long-horizon task composition, reflection, and failure recovery—abilities that are particularly challenging for compact models but essential for persistent interaction in dynamic environments.
items.zh: 结果。如表3所示，Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B在参数可比较的模型中再次获得最高平均分，达到57.4，比Qwen3.6-A3B高出1.4分（57.4 vs. 55.9）。它在VLABench、RoboBench-Planning和RoboFAC上排名第一，在SITE-Bench-Video上排名第二。因此，该模型在时间理解、长期任务组合、反思和失败恢复方面展示了具有竞争力的能力——这些能力对于紧凑型模型尤其具有挑战性，但对于动态环境中的持久交互至关重要。

items.en: Qualitative Analysis. Figure 7 demonstrates three forms of reasoning required for sustained task execution. In long-horizon planning, the model traces how a straight dough rod is progressively rolled and bent into a U shape, then identifies joining the two ends as the next action needed to complete the ring. In progress-aware reasoning, it uses the current contents of a package to select placement of the air-column film as the next subtask and correctly orders shuffled frames of an egg-transfer sequence from approaching, to grasping, transporting, and finally releasing the egg. The reflection examples test whether the model can distinguish intended from actual outcomes: it recognizes that a carrot-cutting attempt failed because the knife never contacted the carrot, and, after a failed cylinder insertion, proposes a concrete recovery plan that reorients the grasp, aligns the cylinder with the target hole, and retries insertion. Rather than merely producing a plausible next action, the model explicitly tracks state changes, diagnoses execution failures, and adapts the plan to recover.
items.zh: 定性分析。图7展示了持续任务执行所需的三种推理形式。在长期规划中，模型追踪一根直的面团条如何逐步滚压并弯曲成U形，然后识别将两端连接作为完成环所需的下一步动作。在进度感知推理中，模型利用包裹中的当前内容选择放置气柱膜作为下一个子任务，并正确地对鸡蛋转移序列的混乱帧进行排序，从接近、抓取、运输到最终释放鸡蛋。反思示例测试模型能否区分意图结果与实际结果：它识别出切胡萝卜尝试失败，因为刀从未接触胡萝卜；在圆柱体插入失败后，它提出了一个具体的恢复计划，包括重新调整抓取方向、将圆柱体对准目标孔，并重试插入。模型不仅仅产生一个似乎合理的下一个动作，而是明确跟踪状态变化、诊断执行失败并调整计划以恢复。

items.capEn: Figure 7: Qualitative analysis of sequential and adaptive reasoning. Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B performs long-horizon action composition, progress-aware temporal reasoning, failure diagnosis, and corrective recovery across human and robotic task sequences.

items.en: We deploy Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B as the decision-making core of two closed-loop navigation agents to evaluate persistent embodied behavior. In both settings, the model operates within a recurrent loop of perception and action: each environment transition updates the observation history and navigation state on which subsequent decisions are conditioned. R2R-CE evaluates language-conditioned trajectory execution, whereas zero-shot Object Goal Navigation on Matterport3D (MP3D) evaluates category-conditioned exploration without route-level guidance. Together, they provide a system-level evaluation of agentic, long-horizon decision-making under two complementary goal specifications. Representative closed-loop rollouts of the resulting navigation agents are illustrated in Figure 8.
items.zh: 我们部署 Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B 作为两个闭环导航智能体的决策核心，以评估持久具身行为。在两个设置中，模型均在感知与动作的循环中运行：每次环境转换会更新观测历史和导航状态，后续决策基于这些信息。R2R-CE 评估语言条件轨迹执行，而 Matterport3D（MP3D）上的零样本物体目标导航评估无路线级引导的类别条件探索。两者共同提供了在两种互补目标规范下对智能体式、长时域决策的系统级评估。生成的导航智能体的代表性闭环展开如图 8 所示。

items.en: Agent Formulation and Evaluation. R2R-CE instantiates Room-to-Room navigation in continuous Matterport3D environments using Habitat. We evaluate on the standard val-unseen split, whose environments are disjoint from training. At each decision step, the policy conditions on the route instruction and accumulated egocentric RGB history. Using role-specific prompts with shared model parameters, the policy performs both action prediction and termination assessment. The model outputs either stop or a finite sequence of low-level navigation actions. Following execution, the newly acquired observation is appended to the history before the policy is queried again. This receding-horizon protocol evaluates instruction grounding, temporal state tracking, corrective decision-making, and terminal-state recognition over extended trajectories. We report Success Rate (SR), Oracle Success (OS), Success weighted by Path Length (SPL), and Navigation Error (NE) under the standard 3 m success criterion.
items.zh: 智能体公式化与评估。R2R-CE使用Habitat在连续的Matterport3D环境中实例化Room-to-Room导航。我们在标准的val-unseen分割上进行评估，其环境与训练环境不相交。在每个决策步骤，策略以路径指令和累积的以自我为中心的RGB历史为条件。通过使用共享模型参数的特定角色提示，策略同时执行动作预测和终止评估。模型输出停止或有限序列的低级导航动作。执行后，新获取的观察结果被追加到历史中，然后再次查询策略。这种递减视野协议评估了在扩展轨迹上的指令基础、时间状态跟踪、纠正性决策和终止状态识别。我们报告在标准3米成功准则下的成功率（SR）、Oracle成功率（OS）、路径长度加权成功率（SPL）和导航误差（NE）。

items.en: Results. As shown in Table 4(a), Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B achieves the best SR (57.9%), SPL (54.2%), and NE (4.5 m), while ranking second in OS (66.4%). items.en: Evaluation Protocol. Object Goal Navigation removes route-level guidance: given only a target category and RGB-D observations, the policy must locate a corresponding instance in an unseen environment and terminate within its success region. The navigation framework derives traversability candidates from depth and maintains an explicit spatial representation across successive observations. Within this framework, Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B performs direction scoring, subgoal selection, target grounding, and action selection. Following each environment transition, the estimated pose and newly acquired observation update the spatial state before the next policy query. All models are evaluated with identical geometric processing and spatial-memory modules, and no model receives ObjectNav-specific parameter adaptation. This controlled protocol evaluates model-level differences in semantic exploration and sequential decision-making. We report SR and SPL.
items.zh: 评估协议。目标目标导航（Object Goal Navigation）去除了路线级引导：仅给定目标类别和RGB-D观测，策略必须在未见环境中定位一个对应的实例并在其成功区域内终止。导航框架从深度中推导出可通行性候选，并在连续观测中维护一个显式的空间表示。在该框架内，Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B执行方向评分、子目标选择、目标锚定和动作选择。每次环境转移后，估计的位姿和新获取的观测更新空间状态，然后进行下一次策略查询。所有模型均使用相同的几何处理和空间记忆模块进行评估，且没有模型接受ObjectNav特定的参数自适应。这种受控协议评估了模型在语义探索和序列决策方面的差异。我们报告SR和SPL。

items.en: Results. As shown in Table 4(b), Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 A3B achieves an SR of 38.3% and an SPL of 11.2%. It outperforms the stronger Qwen3.6-35B-A3B baseline by 2.2 percentage points in SR and 1.4 points in SPL. Because Object Goal Navigation requires route construction through exploration rather than execution of a provided route description, these gains provide complementary evidence for category-conditioned planning, persistent search, and efficient termination.

items.en: In this report, we introduce Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0, an efficient embodied foundation model for physical-world understanding, reasoning, and decision-making. We develop an action-centric capability taxonomy spanning action-relevant state understanding, action-transition reasoning, and sequential and adaptive reasoning, and use it to guide data construction, training, and evaluation. Built on the Hy3-A3B backbone and Hy-ViT2 vision encoder, the model activates only approximately 3B parameters per token while maintaining strong embodied capabilities. Across 38 benchmarks, Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 achieves the best overall performance among models of comparable scale and improves the average score of Hy-Embodied-0.5 MoT-2B by 8.4%. It also demonstrates strong performance on vision-language navigation tasks requiring multi-step interaction and long-horizon reasoning. We hope that Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 provides an efficient and practical foundation for future physical-world agents capable of understanding states, reasoning about actions and transitions, and adapting over time.
items.zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了 Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0，这是一个高效的具身基础模型，用于物理世界的理解、推理和决策。我们开发了一种以动作能力为中心的分类体系，涵盖动作相关的状态理解、动作转换推理以及序列与自适应推理，并以此指导数据构建、训练和评估。该模型基于 Hy3-A3B 骨干和 Hy-ViT2 视觉编码器，每个 token 仅激活约 3B 参数，同时保持强大的具身能力。在 38 个基准测试中，Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 在可比规模的模型中取得了最佳整体性能，并将 Hy-Embodied-0.5 MoT-2B 的平均分数提升了 8.4%。它还在需要多步交互和长期推理的视觉语言导航任务上展现了强大的性能。我们希望 Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 能为未来能够理解状态、推理动作与转换以及随时间适应的物理世界智能体提供高效且实用的基础。
